code.title: Enter your code
code.heading: Enter the code
code.sub: The code your device or application is showing you.
code.meta: Spaces and dashes are ignored, and letters may be typed in either case (RFC 9635 section 4.1.2).
right.reference: an access reference this authorization server attaches no further meaning to
approve.heading: Allow access?
approve.unverified: (as it describes itself; this service has not verified it)
approve.asking: is asking for access on your behalf.
approve.bearer: — a bearer token, usable by whoever holds it
approve.narrowedIntro: This service's issuance policy narrowed what the application asked for before you were asked; it cannot be widened here:
approve.subject: Who you are
approve.nothing: Nothing specific — this request asks only to be continued.
approve.untick: Untick anything you do not want to allow; the application receives only what stays ticked (RFC 9635 section 4).
approve.afterRedirect: Afterwards you are sent back to {uri}.
approve.afterPush: Afterwards the application is notified directly at {uri}.
approve.afterClose: Afterwards you can close this page and return to the application.
done.notTold: {name} could not be told directly; it will find out when it next checks.
done.returnTo: Return to {name}; it will pick up the answer.
sent.title: Sent for approval
sent.heading: Sent to the person it names
sent.sub: This request is for somebody else's account, so you cannot approve it. It is waiting for them on their own portal; the application finds out when they answer.
